documented_root_cause: Liquidity crisis from a demand downturn against fixed costs; survivable with the right sequence.
expected_first_action: Secure committed liquidity first, then right-size the cost base to demand
acceptable_first_actions: Right-size cost base after liquidity is secured
unsafe_first_actions: Cut deep into the viable core before securing liquidity
expected_prioritization_rationale: Sequence matters: secure cash to survive, then restructure costs from a stable footing.
failed_action: Across-the-board panic cost cuts before securing financing (cut into viable core, accelerated decline)
successful_action: Secure committed liquidity, then right-size estate/cost base to demand
why_recovery_worked: Securing liquidity first prevented forced fire-sales and bought time to cut intelligently
outcome_evidence: Documented analog stabilized after financing-then-restructure sequence (UNVERIFIED).
